title: The aging ovary
desc: Sections of 255 ovaries from donors aged 20 to 70, read by deep learning: follicles run out, scars pile up and blood vessels grow fewer. Two methods, one picture of aging.
page: The aging ovary: what 255 ovaries show about aging
aria: Interactive 3D story of how the human ovary changes with age, seen through deep learning on 255 tissue sections
